# Does behavioral post-training transfer to purchase prediction? An actual Smoltaur and Manager comparison

2026-11-26 | Anicca Research

**TL;DR.** On November 26, 2026, we ran 1,536 prompt examples across three cached models on a Mac mini. On 128 purchase sessions, logistic regression scored .703605 AUROC, Smoltaur .427236, and Manager Pilot005 .334223. Paired Brier intervals crossed zero; we did not promote either adapter.

![Research cover](/assets/research/manager-execution-01-transfer-2026-11-26-cover.svg)
Cover: 128 test cases, actual Run01 receipt.

## The problem
A model trained on cognitive experiments may not transfer to another behavioral domain. This benchmark note is for developers familiar with Python and probabilistic classification.

## How we ran it
1. We retrieved the CC BY 4.0 UCI Online Shoppers dataset and fixed a split unused in our own previous pilots.
2. We loaded cached SmolLM2-135M, Smoltaur and Pilot005 on CPU. The first attempt failed on a path-variable collision; the corrected run exited 0. PyTorch 2.11.0, Transformers 4.57.6, PEFT 0.18.1; two newer PEFT config keys were ignored with a warning.
3. We fit logistic regression on 256 cases, calibrated on 128, and evaluated another 128 (21 positive). We averaged each neural model's predictions under two answer orders.
4. We computed 5,000 paired case bootstrap draws for Brier differences. No new neural training.

![Pipeline](/assets/research/manager-execution-01-transfer-2026-11-26-pipeline.svg)
Figure 1. Fixed split and evaluation pipeline, Run01 receipt.

## Results
| Model | Brier | NLL | AUROC |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| logistic | 0.124485 | 0.406451 | 0.703605 |
| base_cal | 0.137169 | 0.446444 | 0.657766 |
| prior | 0.137390 | 0.447285 | 0.500000 |
| smoltaur_cal | 0.137676 | 0.448154 | 0.427236 |
| pilot005_cal | 0.138223 | 0.450537 | 0.334223 |

![Measured AUROC](/assets/research/manager-execution-01-transfer-2026-11-26-chart.svg)
Figure 2. AUROC on the same 128 cases, from Run01 receipt.

Smoltaur minus logistic Brier: .013190, 95% interval [-.001170,.028438]. Pilot005 minus logistic: .013738, [-.001593,.031119]. Both include zero. Pilot005's answer-order gap was .013865 vs Smoltaur .362204; order robustness did not imply better ranking.

## Trade-offs and limitations
We favored an inexpensive cached CPU run over downloading large weights. This is not official Psych-101. Team-wide and pretraining overlap are unknown. Features summarize a completed session, not a prospective intervention. Individual predictions were not saved, AUROC intervals were not computed, and multiple comparisons were not adjusted. No claim of human benefit or production promotion.
